posts.text:
Nace AI has launched Drex Router, which can pick the right AI model for every task.

It routes easy prompts to cheaper models and hard ones to stronger models. In Nace's tests on general knowledge questions, it scored higher than its strongest rival, at about 1/11 of the price.
posts.quoted: Introducing Drex Router. A small model that picks the right LLM/SLM and reasoning effort for every step your agent takes. Accuracy: Drex Router 87.6% vs. Jev Router’s 86.4% Try it: https:// console.nace.ai COMMENT DREX and get extra $5 in API credits

posts.author: testingcatalog
posts.name: AI News | TestingCatalog
posts.text:
Users can keep using the same models, with the routing happening in under a tenth of a second. In Nace's test, building a small game costs $1.26 with Drex Router vs $13.44 using only Claude Opus.

It is now available on the Nace Console, and eligible new accounts get $5 in free

Kong has launched Volcano, a cloud platform that hosts AI apps and agents, bringing everything they need into one place.

Users can build apps with Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex and publish them on Volcano, with built-in database and sign-in functionality.

posts.quoted: At Kong we run half a quadrillion AI tokens a year, and I kept seeing agents stuck on clouds built for websites. So we built a cloud for agents. Volcano is live today: the self-healing agent cloud. Sandboxes, durable workflows, Postgres, hosting.
